nom: The Ordinary Salicylic Acid 2% Solution, Exfoliating Serum for Acne

avis.texte: Really god product how results within weeks of using it. Also the texture tarted to disappear.

I really liked this product and it did help with my acne a lot. it took about a week to see changes, small changes but it still helped. I really, really like this product and I'd definitely buy again!

avis.titre: I wish I knew about this stuff when I was younger
avis.texte: this stuff made me break out bad then I read it was my skin purging so I kept using it. the second week I had clear skin and im to the point I use it every day. no more adult acne.

It does have a little bit of a smell but it fades almost as soon as it sinks into your skin. I've only used it 3 or so times but have noticed my acne starting to disappear and my nose which usually looks like a strawberry is getting smoother and pores look slightly less noticeable. Also my texture has smoothed a bit. Be warned tho, the acne got worse the first day and then it faded with continued use. Just trust the process it's a great product

avis.titre: Legit must have!! Esp for Millia and small bumps!!
avis.texte: This product is getting a bad rap from ppl clearly using a lot of other products for their acne then adding this and burning their own face!! Also no active product that clears acne belongs any where near your eyes!! Ever!! This product has seriously reduced some small bumps and millia I had on my forehead to like 1/4 of the size and I have been using it 2X a day, you only need a small amount. Less is more!! If it's turning white it's cause your putting way to much on at once!! You want your skin to absorb it!! As a chemist who formulated skincare this product and this whole line for the money is a holy grail!!! All of these products work as well as $100 plus products. Just use common sense and use it on the T-zone area and where bumps are located and a thin layer. It will work!! If you on prescription medication for your skin or using a lot of BP or AHA, then don't use this product. Pick one and stick to it and you'll have amazing results!!!
Really nice and affordable. Helped clear my breakouts easily.

avis.titre: Face was bumpy everywhere and burnt and red for 2 weeks.
avis.texte: Ordinary, I love your products, what happened here? This was not a one-time use thing; I finished at least half the bottle, so this review will be as accurate as they can be. I put this on areas where I had acne, and I didn't go in the sun or outside. I followed the instructions on the bottle. The next day, every area where I applied this product was red and had bumps everywhere, and my face stung and was itchy. This stayed like this for 2 weeks, and finally, the bumps and redness went down. My pimple was gone, but I'd rather have a small pimple on my face than have a horrible reaction. A few months later, I tried again, thinking I had just done it wrong. The same thing happened. I kept on repeating this until last month when I tried again. The same reaction happened, and I will just stop using this product completely. My face suffered from this 😭. I still love Ordinary, this is just a personal reaction, I don't know if anyone else had this reaction.
I had used it on my forehead and exit clear up the acne really well, but it had gotten by my eye area and now I have two bad eye infections

If your skin is really dry then i don't recommend this as it is drying! Use a gental hydrating mosterizer and don't forget the sunscreen!

This product has been a GAME CHANGER in my daily facial routine. I have this very prominent area on my cheek that flares up badly from hormonal acne. Since using this product I've noticed an immense change in that one area and consistently clear skin all over my face. I pair this with CosRx "The Alpha-Arbutin 2 Discoloration Care" to help minimize the redness and acne scars. Plus CosRx "Advanced Snail 92 All in One" moisturizer to help balance out the dryness from this product. These pictures are a month and one week apart from each other and it's currently winter months. So super dry air. I would 10/10 recommend this product to almost anyone. I would patch test before applying it all over or adding to your daily routine because it does dry out the skin. I would definitely advise using a good hydrating moisturizer to apply with this product.
Excellent budget serum, has no smell and color, works with systematic use, relieves inflammation, makes the skin cleaner.
This product is so good!! I noticed overnight that my acne scars after a horrible breakout were so much less visible. My skin looks so much clearer now 🫶🏼😌😍

My rash cleared up immensely after just 1 day of not using this product and after just 3 days the rash is now gone. Sad, because the price is reasonable and it worked great before this. After 4 weeks of having zero reactions, and thinking it must be a food issue, I used the salicylic acid serum this morning. 3 hours later I started to feel that telltale burn in the corner of my eyes and I knew what was coming. I immediately took an antihistamine and washed my face. Unfortunately, it's just getting worse. I have allergy testing scheduled in 2 weeks, and will still do that, but it looks like SA is a big part of the equation.

A least twice a week I get compliments on how clear my skin is!! I tell everyone to get this. Its so cheap but its not sacrificing its quality. I dont have cystic acne or anything that I could say that would help others that have stronger acne flare ups; however, I feel like (with consistent use) it would help.

avis.titre: Did such amazing work! Cleared my skin!
avis.texte: If you didn't know, salicylic acid is used to prevent breakouts. When you use any acid at first, It has the chance to break you out because it is a new product to your skin. My skin broke out a little bit for the first 2-3 days. Now, I am on my 3rd bottle, and my skin is glowy and clear. Just make sure to apply a sunscreen is you use it in the morning (I use it day and night) Also, after applying this, don't forget moisturizer to lock it in. Overall, I think this is a great serum, and a must have for my routine!
